notes.title: Improved Cutscene Performance
notes.content:
In this update, we focused on improving performance during cutscenes.

Graphics Optimization (Tip):
We've noticed that many players change all graphics settings when trying to improve performance. However, many settings have a small impact on performance while significantly degrading image quality.

We recommend primarily adjusting the "Render scale" setting. This parameter directly affects the rendering quality of 3D objects, and a small decrease in value will not noticeably reduce graphics quality while significantly increasing performance.

Multiplayer:
•  Fixed an issue with losing focus in the main menu.
•  Fixed a bug where locations were skipped when playing as a quadrober.

notes.title: Achievements and Co-op Improvements
notes.content:
This update introduces 10 new achievements. Additionally, we've addressed several multiplayer issues, including:
  •  Level restart errors
  •  Incorrect key input in the pause menu
  •  Level restart problems after death

notes.title: Cooperative Mode
notes.content:
This is a fully ready beta version of the cooperative mode, allowing you and your friends to play through the game together.

Key Changes:

Complete Playthrough: The cooperative beta allows you to play the entire game from start to finish.
Cooperative Mode Balance: Balance changes have been made for a better cooperative experience:
  •  Skuf: 8 health points (instead of 12 in single-player).
  •  Quadriber: 3 health points (instead of 6 in single-player).
Single-Player Playthrough:
  • Quadriber: 6 health points (formerly 4).

Recommendation: It is recommended that the user with the best performance host the game to minimize slowdowns and other issues, as they will be handling the server-side logic.
